signal: Waymark continues scaling its Medicaid value-based care model, supporting ~50,000 enrollees across Washington and Virginia after $87M raised

email.body1:
Becca, Waymark now supports around 50,000 Medicaid enrollees across Washington and Virginia.

At that scale, the RevOps pain is usually signal-to-action latency: buying signals fire, but the team cannot act on them fast enough, and pipeline leaks before anyone notices. Our AI SDR turns signals into researched, personalized outreach with zero rep time, lifting meetings 3-5x without new headcount.

I built a personalized signal play for Waymark off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Becca, quick follow-up for Waymark.

Most RevOps teams lose pipeline not on data quality but on speed and consistency: signals sit, hand-offs slip, and the measurable lift never shows up. Built-in best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and 3 specific things I would change to shorten signal-to-action latency, every send auto-logged to your CRM.
email.body3:
Becca, last bit of proof for Waymark.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Waymark's reply rate likely compares to other healthcare startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
